name: Vapor Dota 2
description: Dota 2 (app 570) trading shell: read-only inventory read with a tradability/cooldown split, trade-offer listing flagged for Dota items, and one-offer-per-call trade sending behind the explicit 'trade.enabled' gate (default off) with Steam's 7-day market trade cooldown surfaced in validation errors. Reuses the shared trade-offer, confirmation, inventory and rate-limit foundations; crafting, battle-pass and in-match automation stay non-goals.
